h1: Art Nara Hotel Narathiwat — a fresh, clean boutique stay that guests rate higher than you'd expect
intro: In a town that still has few new, design-led places to stay, Art Nara Hotel is a name guests mention with pleasant surprise · A 3-star boutique hotel in the Khok Khian area, on the side of town nearer the airport and Narathat Beach, that scores 9.1 from 12 reviews on Trip.com and around 8.7 on Booking.com · The draw is clean, spacious, neatly designed rooms — including Family and Family-with-Jacuzzi options — free covered parking, and warm hosts (including a resident cat that several guests mention) · From approx ฿700/night.

body.html: Art Nara Hotel is a boutique hotel at 53/85 Moo 7, Khok Khian, in Mueang Narathiwat — on the edge of town nearer the airport and Narathat Beach rather than in the old commercial core · It is about 11 km, roughly 14 minutes by car, from Narathiwat Airport, and sits close to Highway 4136 with easy access out to the beach · Being a fairly new property, it feels fresher and cleaner overall than many of the older hotels in town.

Rooms come in several types, from Twin and Double to Family and a Family-with-Jacuzzi room that is an unusual find at this price point in Narathiwat · They are air-conditioned with flat-screen TVs and en-suite bathrooms with a shower and free toiletries · What guests mention consistently is that rooms are larger than expected and very clean, with an easy-on-the-eye design that feels uncluttered and good value for the price.
"The room was spacious, clean and nicely designed, the service was friendly, there is a 7-Eleven and restaurants nearby, and getting to the airport was very easy."

Beyond the rooms, the most consistent praise is for the warm, friendly service · Many reviews mention attentive hosts who reply quickly and help with travel · A nice detail guests love to tell is the resident cat that wanders over to greet visitors — a small charm that sets the place apart from a standard hotel · The architecture and styling also draw compliments as well chosen and clearly considered, not just plain square rooms.

The trade-off to accept is that there is no in-house restaurant and no breakfast service · If you want coffee or a morning meal you'll head out, though luckily there is a 7-Eleven and local eateries within easy reach · The other point is that the Khok Khian area is not the old commercial centre, so if you plan to stroll the town market or the clock tower every evening you'll need to drive or call a car — the trade is quiet surroundings and easier access out to the beach and airport.

Honestly, with a review base that is still small (12 reviews on Trip.com), the 9.1 score should be read in context — it is a good sign that the people who have stayed are genuinely happy, but it is not a figure built on hundreds of reviews like a big hotel · Even so the picture is clearly consistent: clean, new rooms, good design, warm service and good value among the from-฿700 stays in Narathiwat · For travellers who care about clean, attractive rooms and are driving themselves, this is a sensible pick.

A tip from reading the reviews: if you are travelling as a family or want something a little special, book the Family-with-Jacuzzi room, a rarity at this price · Standard rates start around ฿700 for a Twin and rise with room type and season · Self-drivers have it easy thanks to free covered parking, and if you fly into Narathiwat you can arrange an airport transfer with the hotel in advance (for a charge).

If you want to stroll the market and old town every evening — the Khok Khian area is not the commercial centre, so you'll drive or call a car into town → the trade is quiet surroundings and easier access out to the beach and airport.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Art Nara Hotel Narathiwat

faq.q: Where is Art Nara Hotel in Narathiwat and what is nearby?
faq.a: Art Nara Hotel is at 53/85 Moo 7, Khok Khian, in Mueang Narathiwat · It is on the side of town nearer the airport and Narathat Beach rather than the old commercial core · Narathiwat Airport (NAW) is about 11 km, roughly 14 minutes by car · Narathat Beach and Ao Manao are about 10 minutes by car · There is a 7-Eleven and local eateries within easy reach.

faq.q: How much does Art Nara Hotel cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿700/night for a Twin room · There are Double, Family and a special Family-with-Jacuzzi room to choose from · Prices vary by room type and season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Art Nara Hotel have breakfast and a restaurant?
faq.a: There is no in-house restaurant and no breakfast service · If you want a morning meal or coffee you'll head out, but there is a 7-Eleven and local eateries within easy reach, a short walk or drive away.

faq.q: Who is Art Nara Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers who want clean, new, well-designed rooms and are driving themselves · The Khok Khian location is handy for the airport and Narathat Beach · A Family-with-Jacuzzi room makes it good for families or anyone wanting something a little special at an affordable price.

faq.q: Does it have parking and airport transfers?
faq.a: Yes — there is free covered on-site parking, handy for self-drivers · Airport transfers are available but come at an extra charge; let the hotel know in advance if you are not driving yourself.

The 9.1 comes from 12 reviews on Trip.com, with around 8.7 on Booking.com · The review base is still small, so read it in context — but the feedback that exists is clearly consistent on clean rooms, good design and warm service.
